nodes.label: Top-of-page navigation progress bar
nodes.rationale: A progress bar is architecturally impossible under the current plain <a href> navigation because Chrome freezes the outgoing document during a cross-document navigation (measured: ~1 animation frame over 1382ms of post-click life). Navigation must become client-side (next/link) before any progress UI can render; an indeterminate shimmer (not a timer trickle) is chosen for the interval with no real signal, since a trickle is the exact fake-timer behavior being avoided.
